outputs.explanation: This is a spatial transcriptomics cluster image (micrograph), not a plot of averaged data.
H&E histology images with manual annotations; not a plot showing averages.
H&E image and spatial expression maps; these are micrographs/spatial plots, not summary statistic plots requiring individual data points.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots; per the check criteria, line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.

This bar graph shows a single computed log2 fold-change statistic per gene (with associated p-value) derived from a Wilcoxon rank-sum test between two spot populations via Seurat, not a mean of replicate measurements with error bars, so individual data point overlay is not applicable.
